watches.name: 'Atlantic PRO' Dive Watch (40mm) | Swiss Sellita Automatic | Marine Steel Cat.1
watches.description: **Coming soon** ATLANTIC PRO — THE ATLANTIC, TAKEN FURTHER The Atlantic PRO is the new premium evolution of the Atlantic collection. Built around the proven design language of our original dive watch, Atlantic PRO introduces a higher level of mechanical quality, refinement and finish — while staying true to the stripped-back, purposeful aesthetic that defines Rotate North. At its heart is the Swiss Sellita SW200-1, one of Switzerland's most established automatic mechanical movements. The matt black dial is protected by sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, providing exceptional scratch resistance while improving clarity in changing light. The hands and markers are set in LumiNova, ensuring legibility whatever the conditions. Water-resistant to 30 ATM (300 metres), you can take the Atlantic PRO with you on even the most testing diving, surfing, or wild swimming expedition. However, it's also an easy watch to wear every day, comfortable and understated. The unidirectional ceramic timing bezel provides precise elapsed-time measurement while resisting scratches and fading. Its clean black finish also reinforces the understated design. Functional when you need it. Almost invisible when you don't. The Marine Steel Cat.1 variant is paired with a classic-style stainless steel bracelet, with easy release clasp, and adjustable links, to ensure a comfortable fit at all times. Movement The Atlantic PRO is powered by the Sellita SW200-1, one of Switzerland's most established automatic mechanical movements. Highly serviceable and designed for generations of active use, its 26-jewel construction runs at 28,800 vibrations per hour, delivering the smooth sweep expected from a high-beat Swiss mechanical movement, with 41 hour power reserve when fully wound. It also offers hacking seconds and manual winding, allowing precise time setting. MOVEMENT | Mechanical, 26 jewels, 28,800bph (8 per second). Sellita SW200-1. WINDING | Bi-directional Self Winding via rotor. Additional Manual Winding POWER RESERVE | Approximately 41 hours SHOCK SYSTEM | Diashock FUNCTIONS | Centre hour, minute and seconds hands. Calendar. Unidirectional rotating bezel Model The benchmark for a true diver’s watch is water resistance to 30 ATM (300 metres) and the Atlantic meets this specification. To achieve a water resistance rating of 300m the 316L stainless steel case is fitted with a pressurised screw-down caseback and guarded screw-down crown. watches.name: 'Arctic' 500m Dive Watch (43mm) | Flare Orange
watches.description: Inspired by the Northern hemisphere’s cold saltwater – meet the Arctic , a mechanical diver's watch engineered in Germany and accompanied by a waterproof strap made in Italy from sustainably sourced rubber. Rotate North's design principles; purpose, performance and planet, have informed every detail of the Arctic . The black dial is protected by sapphire crystal, with the hands and markers set in LumiNova, ensuring legibility whatever the conditions, and encased in a matt ceramic bezel. Water-resistant to 50 ATM (500 metres), and with a helium escape valve, the Arctic is a serious diver's watch, able for the toughest of challenges. However, it's also an easy watch to wear every day, comfortable and understated. The Flare Orange edition is distinguished by its vibrant orange strap . Movement The Arctic is powered by a self-winding NH35A, 21,600 BPH automatic, 24 jewel movement, with 41 hour power reserve when fully wound. This robust, mechanical movement is powered entirely by renewable energy drawn from the wearer's own arm movements - no batteries are required. It is exceptionally accurate, highly serviceable and ready for generations of active use. MOVEMENT | Mechanical, 24 jewels, 21,600bph (6 per second). NH35a Manufacture Seiko WINDING | Bi-directional Self Winding via rotor. Additional Manual Winding POWER RESERVE | Approximately 41 hours SHOCK SYSTEM | Diashock FUNCTIONS | Centre hour, minute and seconds hands. Calendar. Unidirectional rotating bezel Model Water resistant to 50 ATM (500 metres), the Arctic is able for the toughest of challenges. To achieve a water resistance rating of 500m the 316L stainless steel case is fitted with a pressurised screw-down caseback, guarded screw-down crown and helium escape valve. CASE ARCHITECTURE | Screw-down case back and winding crown WIDTH | 43 mm (excluding crown) / 48 mm (including crown) LUG-TO-LUG | 50 mm / STRAP WIDTH | 24 mm WEIGHT | 100 grams (excluding strap) CASE THICKNESS | 16 mm (measured at the centre of the watch) CASE MATERIAL | 316L steel / BEZEL | Matt Ceramic CRYSTAL | Sapphire Crystal WINDING CROWN | Screw-down, waterproofness system WATER RESISTANCE | Waterproof to 500 metres / 1,640 feet Strap Made from sustainable rubber in Veneto, Northern Italy, our straps are manufactured in partnership with a small family business that prides themselves on a long-standing tradition of making accessories for the Swiss watch industry as well as many of the world’s finest brands. This NBR compound rubber performance strap is 100% vegan and toughened to withstand the most active outdoor and ocean pursuits. COLOUR | Flare Orange (vibrant orange) LENGTH | 134/75 mm COMPATIBILITY | 24 mm Lug Width STRAP MATERIAL | Natural Rubber STRAP STYLE | Two Piece CLASP STYLE | Buckle (with monogram) CLASP MATERIAL | Stainless Steel (satin finish)
